subject: Amendment required for draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

Please review the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference for the draft Bill of Lading.
We found discrepancies that require your immediate attention and amendment.
For the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
For the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA.
Please update the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction exactly.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
